repos_data.description: Permissionless wallet infrastructure for AI agents. Create wallets, sign transactions, and broadcast on EVM + Solana. Pay and accept x402 payments. Built-in guards. No KYC. Up to 50% less expensive than Coinbase.

Non-custodial Solana swap & limit-order MCP server for AI agents. 21 tools (swap, limit, trailing, TWAP, DCA, combo orders) across Raydium, PumpSwap, Orca, Meteora. Jito MEV-protected. Ed25519 server-message verification. `npx -y @traderouter/trade-router-mcp`
MCP server for Botwallet — Give any AI agent a wallet via Model Context Protocol. FROST threshold signing, x402 paid APIs, spending guard rails.
Safety first. Hardware-verified DeFi for AI agents — designed for when the AI can be compromised.
MCP server for AI agents — Stacks, Celo, Base in one package
x402 pay-per-call MCP server — 22 AI/data/RPC tools, USDC on Base, no API keys
Non-custodial x402 MCP payment layer for AI agents — the open-source alternative to Vercel x402-mcp
MCP server for DeFi execution — lets AI agents swap, provide liquidity, lend, bridge, and run yield strategies across 22 chains
Blockchain JSON-RPC on 23 EVM chains for AI agents (MCP server). Free reads, or x402 pay-per-call. npx -y nodeflare-mcp
Usenami Signer MCP — sign CEX/DEX orders (Binance, OKX, Asterdex) from any MCP-aware AI agent; the signing key never leaves an AWS Nitro Enclave (attested PCR0). 5 tools, stdio.
Cardano MCP server for handling wallet interactions
An MCP server that empowers AI agents to inspect any wallet’s balance and onchain activity across major EVM chains and Solana chain.
